decks.name: LeetCode #102 - Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
decks.description: Return level order traversal of binary tree nodes' values

cards.question: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal: Given the root of a binary tree, return the level order traversal of its nodes' values. (i.e., from left to right, level by level).

solutions.name: Depth First Search
solutions.explanation: Use recursive DFS with depth parameter to track current level. Maintain result array where each index corresponds to tree level. If result array doesn't have list for current depth yet, create empty list. Add current node value to appropriate level list, then recursively process left and right children with incremented depth. O(n) time and space.

solutions.name: Breadth First Search
solutions.explanation: Classic level-order traversal using queue (BFS). Initialize queue with root. For each level, record queue length, process that many nodes by popping from front, collecting values into level array, and adding non-null children to queue. Add completed level to result. Continue until queue empty. Natural approach for level-order traversal with O(n) time and space.
